title: MRI Video Block

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: mri_video_block_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: mri_video_block_heading
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.

fields.label: Heading Highlight
fields.name: mri_video_block_heading_highlight
fields.instructions: Enter the exact words from the heading that should receive visual emphasis.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: mri_video_block_description
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.
fields.default_value: Use a short product video to show how MRI brings property, lease, financial and operational information together for different roles.

fields.label: Items
fields.name: mri_video_block_items
fields.instructions: Add enough items to explain the story clearly. Keep item length and structure consistent, and remove any unused example rows.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Explain the visitor benefit in plain language. Be specific about the workflow or outcome, and avoid jargon or unsupported claims.
sub_fields.default_value: Show a real workflow, not a generic feature montage

fields.label: Video Url
fields.name: mri_video_block_video_url
fields.instructions: Use a stable, approved MRI Software URL. Prefer the canonical destination over a temporary tracking link.

description: Defaults are MRI-focused examples for a commercial real estate marketing landing page. Adapt to the campaign audience, product and region; verify every claim, customer reference and legal statement before publishing.
ai_description: Generate concise, benefit-led MRI Software landing-page copy. Emphasise open and connected real estate technology, connected leasing/finance/operations workflows, portfolio visibility and flexibility. Do not invent metrics, reviews, awards, prices, customer names or implementation timelines.
